eyebrow.zh: Agent 审批 · 本地队列

headline.zh:
少找一个终端，
多看清一次审批。
headline.en:
One approval queue.
Keep each session in view.

sub.zh: agentq 将多个编码 Agent 的审批请求汇入本地网页队列，把你的选择回传给等待中的会话。
sub.en: agentq collects coding-agent approval requests in a local browser queue and returns each choice to the waiting session.

caption.zh: 把分散的审批放进同一个队列
caption.en: Bring scattered approvals into one queue.

body.zh: 每条信封带 agent_id、上下文和选项，答复按 envelope_id 回传。
body.en: Each envelope carries agent_id, context and choices; replies target its envelope_id.

body.zh: serve 使用 bbolt 保存请求和答复，网页与 API 消费同一队列。
body.en: serve stores envelopes and answers in bbolt, shared by the browser and API.

body.zh: 自定义运行时可以提交 HTTP 信封，不必模拟某个终端提示。
body.en: Custom runtimes can submit HTTP envelopes without imitating a terminal prompt.

title.zh: 把分散的审批放进同一个队列
title.en: Bring scattered approvals into one queue.

body.zh: 同时运行多个会话时，审批请求会散落在不同终端。agentq 用带会话标识的 ApprovalEnvelope 把问题汇到同一处，保留选项与上下文，再把答复交回原请求方。你仍然决定每条请求是否应当通过。
body.en: Parallel sessions can leave approval prompts scattered across terminals. agentq collects ApprovalEnvelopes with session labels, choices and context, then returns the answer to the original requester. You still decide which requests to approve.

body.zh: 脚本在临时目录构建并启动真实 daemon，提交一个构造审批请求，再通过 HTTP 选择 n。输出显示队列从 0 变成包含 demo-approval，答复返回原请求，随后队列回到 0。它不启动编码 Agent，不执行审批文字中的动作。
body.en: The script builds and starts the real daemon in a temporary directory, submits one constructed approval and answers n over HTTP. The queue moves from zero to demo-approval, the answer returns to the requester, and the queue returns to zero. It launches no coding agent and executes no action described in the prompt.

body.zh: wrap 识别子进程的提示并生成 ApprovalEnvelope。使用 --daemon 时，它通过本地 HTTP 转发请求；serve 将信封与答复保存到 bbolt，通过 REST 和 WebSocket 提供队列，内嵌网页用于处理请求。attach 生成访问地址和二维码。默认 wrap 仍可使用 stdin/stdout 协议。
body.en: wrap recognizes child-process prompts and produces ApprovalEnvelopes. With --daemon it forwards requests over local HTTP. serve persists envelopes and answers in bbolt and exposes the queue through REST, WebSocket and an embedded page. attach generates an access URL and QR code. Plain wrap also supports the stdin/stdout protocol.

body.zh: agentq 将多个编码 Agent 的审批请求汇入本地网页队列，把你的选择回传给等待中的会话。
body.en: agentq collects coding-agent approval requests in a local browser queue and returns each choice to the waiting session.

body.zh: 演示只验证本地 HTTP 审批往返，不验证手机网络、真实 Agent 或所有终端交互。
body.en: The demo verifies a local HTTP approval round trip, not phone networking, real agents or every terminal interaction.

note.zh: v0.11.0 的真实本地 HTTP 往返。输出由示例从实际响应提取稳定字段，不包含动态时间戳；这不是手机、LAN 或第三方 Agent 兼容性验收。
note.en: A real local HTTP round trip on v0.11.0. The example extracts stable fields from actual responses, omitting dynamic timestamps. It is not phone, LAN or third-party agent compatibility acceptance.

body.zh: 脚本在临时目录构建并启动真实 daemon，提交一个构造审批请求，再通过 HTTP 选择 n。输出显示队列从 0 变成包含 demo-approval，答复返回原请求，随后队列回到 0。它不启动编码 Agent，不执行审批文字中的动作。
body.en: The script builds and starts the real daemon in a temporary directory, submits one constructed approval and answers n over HTTP. The queue moves from zero to demo-approval, the answer returns to the requester, and the queue returns to zero. It launches no coding agent and executes no action described in the prompt.

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+；下方自带协议示例还需要 Python 3。构建时可能下载 Go 依赖，示例只访问回环地址。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+ and Python 3 for the supplied protocol demo. Building may download Go dependencies; the demo only contacts loopback.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/agentq.git
cd agentq
go build -o agentq ./cmd/agentq

limitations.zh: 演示只验证本地 HTTP 审批往返，不验证手机网络、真实 Agent 或所有终端交互。
limitations.en: The demo verifies a local HTTP approval round trip, not phone networking, real agents or every terminal interaction.

limitations.zh: 自动批准是可选 glob 规则，不对请求的安全性作推理。
limitations.en: Optional automatic approval matches globs; it does not reason about request safety.
